name: coding-feature-add-verbose-flag
description: Feature: add a --verbose CLI flag that enables debug logging

turns.userMessage: Add a `--verbose` CLI flag to this tool. When set, all debug-level log messages should print to stderr. Update the arg parser, config interface, and wire the flag into the command runner.

mockResponses.text: Added `--verbose` flag support: (1) `CliConfig` now has a `verbose: boolean` field, (2) `parseArgs` detects `--verbose` in argv and strips it before parsing commands, (3) `runCommand` uses a `debug()` helper that prints to stderr only when verbose is enabled.
